d.a: Distribution. China (Guizhou). Known only from the cave Da Dong in Shuicheng (Figure 7). Da Dong is located in Tuoluo village, opening on a sub hill and with a large entrance. Inside this short cave there are some nice speleothems. A small underground stream runs through the main passage, which is wet in most parts. Unfortunately, the cave fauna is very poor. In order to get more material, we visited this cave in July 2020 and searched carefully throughout the main passage but found nothing.
